description.ncbi_summary: Enables polyubiquitin modification-dependent protein binding activity. Involved in cellular response to lipopolysaccharide; negative regulation of I-kappaB kinase/NF-kappaB signaling; and toll-like receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in cytosol. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Binds to zinc finger protein TNFAIP3 and inhibits NF-kappa-B activation induced by tumor necrosis factor, Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), interleukin-1 and 12-O-tetradecanoylphorbol-13-acetate. Overexpression inhibits NF-kappa-B-dependent gene expression in response to lipopolysaccharide at a level downstream of TRAF6 and upstream of IKBKB. NF-kappa-B inhibition is independent of TNFAIP3 binding.
